Promoter Group list (Indian category):
- Sr.57 - On 29th June 2026, Mahindra Summit Agriscience Limited ceased to be part of the Promoter Group of Swaraj Engines Limited. This entity is no longer part of the Promoter Group under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
- Sr.94 - On 16th September 2025, Mahindra & Mahindra Contech Limited ceased to be part of the Promoter Group of Swaraj Engines Limited. This entity is no longer part of the Promoter Group under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
- Sr.96 - On 16th September 2025, Kota Farm Services Limited ceased to be part of the Promoter Group of Swaraj Engines Limited. This entity is no longer part of the Promoter Group under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
- Sr.101 - On 2nd March, 2026, Blue Planet Integrated Waste Solutions Limited ceased to be part of the Promoter Group of Swaraj Engines Limited. This entity is no longer part of the Promoter Group under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
Promoter Group list (Foreign category):
- Sr.15 - On 30th October 2025, Mahindra Aerospace Australia Pty. Limited ceased to be part of the Promoter Group of Swaraj Engines Limited. This entity is no longer part of the Promoter Group under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
- Sr.51 - On 10th June 2025, MLL Global Logistics Limited ceased to be part of the Promoter Group of Swaraj Engines Limited. This entity is no longer part of the Promoter Group under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
- Sr.57 - On 30th September 2025, Mahindra & Mahindra Limited (promoter company) sold its entire stake in Sampo Rosenlew Oy (Sampo). As a result, Sampo Rosenlew ceased to be a wholly-owned subsidiary of the promoter company and, therefore, is no longer a promoter group company of Swaraj Engines Limited under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
- Sr.58 - On 14th August 2025, Mahindra & Mahindra Limited (promoter company) had sold its entire stake in Mahindra Ideal Lanka (Private) Limited (MILPL). As a result, MILPL ceased to be a Associate Company of the promoter company and, therefore, is no longer a promoter group company of Swaraj Engines Limited under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018
